p.i: chius Scaphusianus, Gregorius Richterus Gorlicensis, Theologi: V Volfgangus item Meierus Theologiæ Doctor in inclyta Basilea: cui uni acceptum refero, quod Epistolas MSS. Capitonis, Buceri, Musculi, Oecolampadij, aliorum, novi, quas ut selectas literato orbi communicet per Chalcographorum operam, publicâ illum voce cohortor. Quod si horum liberalitatem alij fuerint imitati, & Deus voluerit animulam hanc in corpusculi hujus ergastulo unum adhuc atq; alterum annum habitare: erunt fortasis, qui suis votis in hoc genere aliqua ex parte satisfactum esse, fatebuntur.

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment: the opening words are cut off at the left edge ("chius" is probably "Vitus" or similar, the start of a name list); the initial letters are damaged and read as printed. "Errata" is set in bold roman at the right, separated from the text. Doubtful: "chius" first word; "Volfgangus" as printed.
